notConfigured.title: This installation has no legal texts
notConfigured.body: Whoever runs it hasn't set up their details as data controller: it is an installation for personal use. If you were given an account on it, ask them who processes your data and how.

consent.label: I have read and accept the <terms>terms and conditions</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
consent.required: You have to accept them to continue.

accept.title: Before you go on
accept.description: To use the application on this installation, accept its terms and its privacy policy (version {{version}}). Open them to read them: they open in a new tab.

errors.passwordPolicy: The password must be at least 8 characters long and include letters and numbers

forgotPassword.subtitle: We will send you a link to choose a new password.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Saving it signs you out of every open session.
resetPassword.success: Password saved. Sign in with the new one.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link isn’t valid: it was already used, it expired or it is incomplete. Each link works only once.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: Confirming your email protects your account and enables the features that need it.
verifyEmail.success: Email verified. You can now use every feature.
verifyEmail.invalidLink: This link isn’t valid: it was already used, it expired or it is incomplete. If your email is not verified yet, request another one from the notice in the application.
verifyEmail.banner: Confirm your email: when you signed up we sent a link to {{email}}.
verifyEmail.bannerResent: Link sent again to {{email}}. It expires in 24 hours; if you don’t see it, check your spam folder.

fields.staleAfterDays: Flag applications with no activity after (days)

timezone.placeholder: Search for a city or region
timezone.description: It is detected from your browser when you sign in. Change it if it isn’t yours.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Your account and all your data will be permanently deleted: applications with their history, companies, interviews, reminders, documents and your profile. To keep them, download them first with “Download all my data”, on this same page.
delete.dialogDescription: This can't be undone. All your data will be deleted and you'll be signed out.

export.title: Your data
export.description: Download everything you have in the application as a .zip: applications with their history, companies, interviews, reminders, your profile, AI proposals and preferences, each in its own JSON file, plus all your PDFs. Your AI keys are never included.

password.title: Password
password.description: To change it, type your current password and the new one. Saving it signs you out of your other sessions; this one stays open.
password.changed: Password changed. We’ve signed you out of your other sessions.
password.forgottenHint: We’ll send {{email}} a link to choose another one. Saving it signs you out of every session, this one included.
password.sent: Link sent to {{email}}. It expires in 1 hour; if you don’t see it, check your spam folder.

email.title: Email
email.pending: Confirm this email is yours with the link we sent when you signed up. If you can’t find it or it expired, request another one.
email.unavailable: This installation doesn’t send emails, so the email can’t be verified from here.

nav.theme: Switch between light and dark theme

companies.emptyDescription: They are created when you add an application, or you can add them here.

interviews.empty: No interviews yet for this application.

reminders.empty: No pending reminders for this application.
reminders.emptyPendingDescription: Create one so you don’t forget the next step of an application.
reminders.deleteConfirm: It will be deleted for good. Deleting done or dismissed reminders frees up room in your account limit.

welcome.title: Start by adding your first application

documents.emptyArchived: There are no matching archived documents.

generate.title: Generate a CV from your profile
generate.description: Choose the design and what to include. The CV keeps your profile as it is now: editing it later will not change this CV.

usage.title: Account usage
usage.description: How much of each limit of your account you have used. They don’t renew: you free up room by deleting applications, companies, reminders or documents. Archiving an application or a document, or completing a reminder, doesn’t free up room. Free AI uses do not come back.

notifications.title: Email notifications
notifications.description: Choose what you want to hear about by email. Every email has a link to turn that notification off.
notifications.unverified: Notifications are only sent to a verified email. Verify it in the Email card to start receiving them.
notifications.unavailable: This installation doesn't send email, so there are no email notifications.
notifications.unavailableHint: If whoever runs it sets up email, you’ll be able to choose notices here for overdue reminders, upcoming interviews, inactive applications and a weekly summary.

notify_reminder_due.label: Reminder due
notify_reminder_due.description: When a pending reminder reaches its date, or earlier if you choose so.

notify_weekly_digest.label: Weekly summary
notify_weekly_digest.description: On Monday mornings: pending items, this week's interviews and stalled applications.

notify_stale.label: Applications without activity
notify_stale.description: When an application goes past the days without activity you set in Preferences.

notify_ai_proposal.label: Finished AI proposal
notify_ai_proposal.description: When a tailored CV or cover letter you asked the AI for is finished, in case you left while it was being prepared. The application already tells you if you are still in it.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.subtitle: Applications Tracker email notifications
unsubscribe.question: Stop receiving “{{notification}}” emails? Your other notifications stay as they are.
unsubscribe.done: Done: you will no longer receive “{{notification}}” emails. You can turn them back on at any time in Preferences.

profile.description: What you add here is the raw material for your CVs: only what is in your profile can appear in a CV.

consent.title: Send data to {{provider}}
consent.description: To tailor your CV, the application sends part of your profile and the job offer to {{provider}}, this installation's AI provider.

sent.profile: Your experience and achievements, your education, projects and certifications, your skills and languages, your headline and your summary.
sent.offer: The job description of this application.

consent.notSent: Your name, email, phone, location or links: they are added when the PDF is created.
consent.revoke: You can withdraw this consent whenever you want.

review.title: Review the tailored CV
review.warning: Review every change before creating the PDF: the AI reorders and rewords what is in your profile, but it can exaggerate. What you leave here is what the PDF will say.
review.outdated: Your profile has changed since this proposal was made and no longer includes something it suggests. Ask for a new proposal.
review.experienceHint: Experience follows the suggested order. Job title, company and dates come from your profile.
review.noExperience: The CV needs at least one experience.
review.skillsHint: The ones in the CV, by importance for the job.
review.gaps: What the job asks for that isn't in your profile
review.gapsHint: It isn't added to the CV: if you have it, add it to your profile.
review.generateHint: Choose the design. It doesn't use the AI again: you can create several designs from this proposal.

problems.experiences: The CV needs at least one experience.

match.title: Match with the job
match.description: How much of what the job asks for appears in the CV, in the same words. It is what an ATS filter looks at, not the chance of getting a call. It changes as you edit.
match.toImprove_one: {{count}} requirement you have does not count: check the ones in amber.
match.toImprove_other: {{count}} requirements you have do not count: check the ones in amber.

states.unnamed: You have it, in other words
states.dropped: In your profile, but not in this CV

hints.unnamed: According to the AI, your profile shows it here, but not in the words the job uses. If it is true, name it in the achievement.
hints.dropped: Your profile names it, but this version of the CV does not: bring back the achievement or skill that says it.
hints.missing: It is not in your profile. If you have it, add it to your profile.

letter.warning: Review the letter before creating it: the AI writes from your profile, but it may exaggerate or claim something that is not in it. What you leave here is what the PDF will say.
letter.title: Letter
letter.hint: Your name, contact details, the date, the company and the position are added by the template.
letter.noSources: Not based on your profile. That is normal in the opening or the closing; if it claims something about you, check that it is true.
letter.noParagraphs: The letter needs at least one paragraph.
letter.generateHint: Choose the design: the letter uses the same ones as the CV. It doesn't use the AI again.

problems.paragraphs: The letter needs at least one paragraph.

settings.title: Artificial intelligence
settings.description: What tailors your CV and writes your cover letters, and who your data is sent to for that.
settings.keysHint: With your own key from a provider there is no usage limit: you pay for it in your provider account. It is checked when you save it, stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings.getKeyLabel: How to get a {{provider}} key (opens in a new tab)
settings.modelRetired: This model is no longer available in this installation: choose another to keep using the key.
